7107: Sit in the machine and put one foot on the platform.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the platform away until your leg is almost straight.
Lower slowly until your knee bends to about 90 degrees.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
7108: Sit with your back against the pad and shins behind the roller.
Align your knees with the machine pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
7113: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Keep a slight softness in your elbows and brace your core.
Lower the weight in an arc back over your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips on the bench.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest.
7114: Stand tall holding the EZ bar with a shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang in front of your thighs.
Pull it up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop around chest height without shrugging hard.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.
7129: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Bend one knee and bring the heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the back of your thigh at the top.
7154: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Shuffle sideways for a few steps.
Lift your knees high with each step.
Stay light on your feet and pump your arms.
Change direction and continue for 30-60 seconds.
7155: Sit with a low cable behind you, holding the handle behind your back.
Keep your arms straight and chest tall.
Shrug your shoulders up and slightly back.
7175: Put on skates, helmet and pads, and stand with your knees slightly bent.
Push one skate out to the side and glide on the other.
Alternate pushes with a relaxed arm swing.
Keep your chest up and your weight over the skates.
Skate at a steady pace for 10-30 minutes.
7176: Sit in the machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Lower your heels slowly for a good stretch.
7177: Sit in the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Rest the other foot on the floor or the support.
Press up through your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heel slowly for a full stretch.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
7194: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Hop and cross one foot in front of the other.
Hop back out, then step one foot back behind you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet each time.
Alternate sides for the planned time.
7198: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band just above your knees.
Press through your heels to lift your hips.
At the top, push your knees apart against the band.
7199: Lie on your side with the band above your knees and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and rest your head on your arm.
Lift your top knee up against the band without rolling back.
Keep your feet together like a clamshell.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
